purpose: Backend runtime manifest for the scikit-learn 1.9.1-compatible re-serialized Component 1 pipelines (Phase 1 ML runtime).

transformation.description: One-time compatibility re-serialization: load original 1.7.2-fit joblib artifact under scikit-learn 1.9.1 (with loader-side sys.modules['_loss'] -> sklearn._loss._loss alias equal to the 1.7.2 runtime state, plus exact-value SimpleImputer._fill_dtype = _fit_dtype state completion), then re-dump with joblib 1.6.0. No refit, no parameter change, no feature change. Candidates load natively under 1.9.1 without the alias.

evidence.note: The evidence workspace is a temporary directory; the essential evidence is embedded in this manifest and in the hard-coded trusted hashes in model_loader.py.

transformation.parity_result: PASS - bit-identical predictions on 50 deterministic held-out test rows and 12 edge rows per model (max abs diff 0.0); tapping labels exact and probability column order [High, Low, Moderate] preserved; identical ValueError rejection of non-finite (inf) inputs.

models.name: drc_prediction
models.deployment_note: Copy of the CV-selected, train-fitted pipeline. Not refit on the full dataset; the test partition was used only for one-time evaluation. month and day_of_year are derived by the backend from the observation-local timestamp (training used naive local timestamps).

models.name: price_estimation
models.deployment_note: Copy of the CV-selected, train-fitted pipeline. Not refit on the full dataset; the test partition was used only for one-time evaluation. latex_drc_pct may be supplied by the drc_prediction model output or by a measured value; the research price model never consumes estate_id.

models.name: tapping_advisory
models.deployment_note: Copy of the CV-selected, train-fitted classifier bundle ({'pipeline', 'label_encoder', 'classes', 'warning'}). Not refit on the full dataset. predict_proba column order is exactly the classes order above (High=0, Low=1, Moderate=2).
models.target_warning: Rule-derived proxy labels with ~30% simulated label noise (seed 340); NOT expert-verified tapping advice.

research_provenance.embedded_preprocessing: Median imputation (numeric; StandardScaler for tapping model) and most-frequent imputation + one-hot encoding (categorical, handle_unknown='ignore') are embedded inside each sklearn Pipeline and were fitted on the training partition only.

known_limitations: Dataset is fully synthetic; outputs are not real-world evidence and must not be presented as agronomic fact.
Models were fitted on the training partition only (never refit on the full dataset).
Tapping suitability labels are rule-derived proxies with ~30% simulated label noise (seed 340) and are NOT expert-verified tapping advice.
month and day_of_year are derived from observation-local timestamps matching training's naive local-time semantics; any timezone conversion must be explicit and documented (never silent UTC).

Out-of-range and missing sensor values are treated as missing and median-imputed inside the pipeline; the pipelines reject non-finite (inf) inputs with ValueError - callers must validate inputs before inference.
Estate identifiers seen only as unseen categories at fit time are handled by one-hot ignore_unknown (all-zero encoding); estate_name is never a model feature.
